shared_elements: tall stone slab/stele with rounded or tapering top
horizontal band of triangles / zigzag running across the width
row of repeated upright units set in a register above the triangle band
plain or lightly worked lower field beneath the decorated zone
incised/carved linear detailing on a monolithic surface
justification: The most specific correspondence is the shared vertical scheme: a register of repeated upright elements across the upper part of a tall slab, immediately underlined by a horizontal band of triangles/zigzag, with the surface below left comparatively open. The biggest difference is the manner of rendering and content — A is modelled low relief with recognisable animals (quadrupeds, a bird, discs) photographed in situ, whereas B is a thin incised, wholly abstract/geometric design known only through a line drawing.
